tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Browse apps listed on Shipyard, newest or most upvoted first.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: One listing by id, with its upvotes, reactions and screenshots.

tools.name: my_projects
tools.description: Listings in your workspaces, taken-down ones included.

tools.name: ship_project
tools.description: List an app on Shipyard. Its page is public at once. Give `handle` to start your workspace if you have none, or `workspace` if you are in more than one.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Change a listing's details. Only the fields you give change.

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: Your listing's board: threads where people ask about what the app does, best fit first, each with a suggested first reply that helps without naming the app. Post replies yourself, from your own account. Needs a subscribed workspace.

tools.name: mark_opportunity
tools.description: Mark a board card posted (give reply_url, the link to your own reply, so Shipyard watches for replies to it), dismissed, or live again.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_opportunities · Public sink: list_opportunities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_opportunities · Public sink: list_opportunities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_projects" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Browse or search the Shipyard feed. Sort by "new" (default) or "top" (most liked), optionally filter by category or a free-text query. Set mine=true to list only your own projects (needs an API key)." → after: "Browse apps listed on Shipyard, newest or most upvoted first."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
